moderation_actions_restrict_target.name: moderation_actions_restrict_target
moderation_actions_restrict_target.value: "moderation_actions"."kind" NOT IN ('restrict', 'restore') OR (("moderation_actions"."post_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("moderation_actions"."user_id" IS NOT NULL))

posts_published_at_when_published.name: posts_published_at_when_published
posts_published_at_when_published.value: "posts"."base_status" NOT IN ('limited', 'public', 'unpublished') OR "posts"."published_at" IS NOT NULL

runs_daily_fields.name: runs_daily_fields
runs_daily_fields.value: ("runs"."mode" = 'daily') = ("runs"."theme_id" IS NOT NULL AND "runs"."date" IS NOT NULL)

runs_ended_iff_ended_at.name: runs_ended_iff_ended_at
runs_ended_iff_ended_at.value: ("runs"."ended" IS NOT NULL) = ("runs"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL)

sessions_miss_below_requires_run.name: sessions_miss_below_requires_run
sessions_miss_below_requires_run.value: "sessions"."miss_below" IS NULL OR ("sessions"."run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."is_new" = false)

sessions_turn_iff_run.name: sessions_turn_iff_run
sessions_turn_iff_run.value: ("sessions"."turn" IS NOT NULL) = ("sessions"."run_id" IS NOT NULL)
